title: Container mode: chown the claude-code-config volume to HOST_UID + re-assert bypass flag in ensure-up (CAM-175 blocker)
description: CAM-175 live ceremony (2026-07-04, v0.59.0) found container mode non-functional for real workers due to a single root cause with two symptoms. ROOT CAUSE: the named docker volume claude-code-config mounts root-owned (0:0, 755) at /home/bun/.claude (src/supervisor/worker-container.ts:217), shadowing the dir that the Dockerfile chown -R re-owned at build time (a runtime volume mount always covers the build-time dir). CONSEQUENCE 1: claude (uid 501 bun) cannot mkdir /home/bun/.claude/session-env -> every worker Bash tool call fails EACCES -> the implementer cannot run git/gates. CONSEQUENCE 2: unable to persist accept-state to the root-owned dir, claude rewrites /home/bun/.claude.json and DROPS bypassPermissionsModeAccepted (baked true by CAM-179 becomes null), so the interactive Bypass Permissions modal reappears and hangs the worker at a 1/2 accept prompt. FIX VALIDATED LIVE: docker exec -u root chown -R HOST_UID:HOST_GID /home/bun/.claude + re-assert bypassPermissionsModeAccepted:true in .claude.json -> a fresh dispatch skipped the modal (modal-lines 0), ran bash with zero EACCES, ran typecheck ok, committed + pushed the story from inside the container. PROPOSED FIX: in the ensure-up container path (alongside the CAM-176 firewall apply, after ensureWorkerContainer and before dispatch): (1) chown -R HOST_UID:HOST_GID /home/bun/.claude to un-shadow the root-owned volume, (2) defensively re-assert bypassPermissionsModeAccepted:true (and the 5 CAM-179 keys) in /home/bun/.claude.json since claude strips the baked value on rewrite. Idempotent, mirrors the firewall wiring pattern. SECONDARY OBSERVATIONS (file follow-ups if they reproduce): (a) in-container bun test showed 2957 pass / 10 fail vs 3012 green on host; confirm whether the 10 are container-env-specific; (b) the container image has no jq (worker fell back to bunx/python); consider installing jq in the Dockerfile since agent scripts assume it. This is the CAM-175 definitive-gate blocker: container mode is otherwise verified GREEN end-to-end (firewall converges, egress allow anthropic+github / block example.com, /workspace writable + round-trip, story GREEN in-container).

spec.scope: Fix container mode's root-owned /home/bun/.claude named volume (the last CAM-175 blocker) at BOTH layers so real workers run without EACCES and without the interactive Bypass Permissions modal. ROOT CAUSE: the image has no bun-owned /home/bun/.claude directory, so the claude-code-config named volume mounts empty and Docker creates the mountpoint root-owned, shadowing the build-time chown. BUILD-TIME (root-cause, fresh volumes): in .devcontainer/Dockerfile, mkdir /home/bun/.claude BEFORE the `chown -R $HOST_UID:$HOST_GID /home/bun` step (line ~66) so a freshly-created named volume inherits bun ownership on first mount; also add jq to the apt-get install line (agent scripts assume jq; container currently lacks it). RUNTIME (self-heal existing volumes + reused-container config): add a new module src/supervisor/container-config.ts mirroring container-firewall.ts (pure argv builder + non-throwing orchestrator returning a {ok:true}|{ok:false,exitCode,stderrTail} union + typed error thrown by the caller), wired UNCONDITIONALLY into ensureWorkerContainer alongside the firewall apply (ensure-container.ts ~207-212, gated on an injected spawn seam like firewallSpawnFn) to (a) chown -R HOST_UID:HOST_GID /home/bun/.claude on every ensure-up and (b) re-assert the CAM-179 keys in /home/bun/.claude.json jq-free (in-container node, or the newly-added jq) so a reused container whose config claude rewrote still starts zero-prompt. Fail-closed in runSidecar (sidecar.ts ~1156-1169) via a new instanceof arm on the typed error, mirroring FirewallError: log + return before runSidecarLoop, no worker dispatched. Out of scope (separate issues): the 10 in-container test failures (CAM-186).
acceptanceCriteria: BUILD-TIME: .devcontainer/Dockerfile creates /home/bun/.claude as a directory BEFORE the `chown -R $HOST_UID:$HOST_GID /home/bun` step, so a freshly-created claude-code-config named volume mounts bun-owned rather than root-owned.
BUILD-TIME: .devcontainer/Dockerfile installs jq in the apt-get install line alongside the existing packages (git nodejs npm sudo iptables ipset dnsmasq dnsutils curl).

RUNTIME MODULE: a new src/supervisor/container-config.ts mirrors container-firewall.ts exactly: a pure argv builder, a non-throwing orchestrator returning a {ok:true}|{ok:false,exitCode,stderrTail} discriminated union, and a typed error class thrown by the CALLER (ensureWorkerContainer), never by the orchestrator.

RUNTIME CHOWN: the step runs `chown -R HOST_UID:HOST_GID /home/bun/.claude` inside the container on every ensure-up, wired UNCONDITIONALLY into ensureWorkerContainer alongside the firewall apply, gated on an injected spawn seam (mirroring firewallSpawnFn); HOST_UID/HOST_GID come from resolveHostIds already computed in makeProductionEnsureContainerFn.

RUNTIME CONFIG RE-ASSERT: the step idempotently re-asserts the 5 CAM-179 keys (hasCompletedOnboarding, theme, bypassPermissionsModeAccepted, projects[/workspace].hasTrustDialogAccepted, hasCompletedProjectOnboarding) in /home/bun/.claude.json on every ensure-up, jq-free (in-container node or the newly-added jq), merging (not clobbering claude's own state like machineID/userID). The implementer verifies empirically whether it is still needed after the ownership fix and includes it as idempotent defense (default: include).

FAIL-CLOSED: failure of the chown or the config re-assert causes ensureWorkerContainer to throw a typed error caught by a NEW instanceof arm in runSidecar (sidecar.ts), which logs the stderrTail and returns before runSidecarLoop (no worker dispatched), mirroring the FirewallError catch.

TESTS: unit tests mirror the firewall suite: pure argv assertions, orchestrator with injectable fake spawnFn (ok + fail cases + never-throws), typed-error tests, unconditional-integration tests in ensure-container (all reconcile branches + absent-seam no-op), and sidecar fail-closed tests (runSidecarLoop NOT called on the new error, resolves without throwing, non-matching errors rethrow).
GATES: bun run typecheck, bun test, and bun run check:all are all green on the host.

VERIFICATION (operator/manual, re-confirms CAM-175 gates c/d without the live chown workaround): a real container dispatch after the fix runs a worker with zero EACCES bash failures and no Bypass Permissions modal, on BOTH a freshly-created volume AND a pre-existing root-owned volume (self-heal).
gotchas: The claude-code-config named volume SHADOWS the build-time dir: build-time mkdir+chown fixes FRESH volumes only; existing dev machines have a stale root-owned volume that the runtime chown self-heals (no manual `docker volume rm` needed). Docker copies image-dir ownership into a named volume only on the FIRST (empty) mount.
/home/bun/.claude.json is a SIBLING file (NOT under the volume); chowning the .claude DIR does not fix the FILE content, so the config re-assert is a distinct step from the chown.

claude STRIPS the baked bypassPermissionsModeAccepted:true on its first config rewrite; the re-assert must run on EVERY ensure-up (reused containers persist a corrupted .claude.json across ensure-up ticks via the 'running reuse' reconcile branch), not just at build.
Container image currently has NO jq (added by this fix); until/unless jq is used, jq-free JSON edits go through in-container node (nodejs is installed).

Mirror the CAM-176 firewall pattern EXACTLY: the orchestrator NEVER throws; the throw lives in ensureWorkerContainer; the sidecar catches via instanceof. A new typed error needs its OWN instanceof arm in sidecar.ts:1156-1169 or it hits the bare `throw e` (line ~1167) and crashes the sidecar instead of failing closed.

ensure-container.ts:207-212 is the exact wiring region (the `if (opts.firewallSpawnFn !== undefined)` block); the container name defaults to DEFAULT_CONTAINER_NAME inside ensureWorkerContainer (worker-container.ts:147).
